title: Blindness certificate
description: Serialized evidence that a candidate observation fails to cover a hazard, or that it covers it. Mirrors the certified finite decision in the Atlas kernel; the JSON form is project-specific and is never checked into the Atlas.

atlasCommit.description: Exact Atlas commit whose kernel semantics this certificate refers to.

executions.description: Names of the finitely many executions.

coalition.description: Principals whose private evidence the candidate may read. Must be a subset of architecture.principals.

kind.description: local = a single principal's declared emitted view; emittedArchitecture = arbitrary computation over the tuple of all currently emitted views; joint = a permitted predicate over coalition-indexed private evidence.

collisionWitness.description: A pair of executions agreeing at the candidate output but disagreeing on the hazard.

sharedOutput.description: Optional rendering of the common candidate output.

mechanism.description: Informational mechanism under which the certificate is claimed. Results in this release are stated under the fixed truthful mechanism M0 only.
